components.name: Stress survival
components.threshold: Through any ≥50% ETH drawdown, the ETH-system NET collateral share across Aave/Morpho/Sky (Sky USDC PSM, pure lenders and same-class loops excluded) falls ≤5pp AND no top venue delists ETH or cuts max LTV >10pp.
components.valueText: ETH-system NET collateral 54.8% · share -6.3pp over tracked window · drawdown from peak −63%
components.detail: Seed 0.5 — eligibility held through the 2022 drawdown, but stablecoin/T-bill collateral was not yet at scale. The real test is the next ≥50% drawdown. ⚠ Caution: amid the current −63% drawdown, the ETH-system NET collateral share has fallen 6.3pp (>5pp) — a soft fail of the light condition, pending the manual delist/LTV check.

components.name: Demand-side enforcement
components.threshold: A venue restricting ETH collateral demonstrably loses TVL share, OR ETH retains the top LTV tier in venues that also list tokenized-treasury collateral.
components.detail: Lights when an ETH-restricting venue loses TVL share, or ETH keeps the top LTV tier where tokenized-treasuries also compete.

components.name: Slashable ETH bond demand
components.threshold: ETH restaked across EigenLayer / Symbiotic / Karak, ETH-denominated (price-stripped). Lights at ≥5M ETH bonded; ≥1M = partial; reverse (Schelling-retired) if it collapses <1M. Headline TVL over-reads — points-farming, LST double-count, non-live-slashing AVSs.
components.detail: 3.03M ETH restaked (EigenLayer+Symbiotic+Karak, ETH-denominated). Lights at ≥5M; ≥1M = partial. NB: headline TVL over-reads real demand (points-farming, LST double-count, non-live-slashing AVSs).

components.name: Institutional tabularization
components.threshold: ≥2 regulated venues (prime broker, CCP/clearinghouse, or regulated margin program) list ETH on a collateral eligibility schedule with haircut ≤40%, LIVE (not announced).
components.detail: Lights at ≥2 regulated venues (PB / CCP / margin program) listing ETH on a collateral schedule with haircut ≤40%, LIVE.

components.name: Volatility / haircut regime
components.threshold: ETH trailing-365d realized vol persistently <50% (annualized, daily log returns; persistent = <50% for ≥2 consecutive quarters) AND regulated-venue haircut quotes trending down.
components.detail: Auto leg — trailing-365d realized vol <50% for ≥2 quarters: not met. Manual leg — regulated-venue haircuts compressing: unconfirmed.

components.name: Duration
components.threshold: Fixed-term (≥90-day) borrowing against ETH collateral ≥10% of total ETH-collateralized debt (Pendle / Morpho fixed-term / Term Finance / Notional).
components.detail: Fixed-term (≥90d) ETH-collateral borrowing as a share of total ETH-collateral debt. Lights at ≥10%.

collateral.method: NET collateral (rule B): Aave DL-net + Morpho per-market net + Sky vault-only (USDC PSM/savings excluded). Morpho held flat across the 18m drift (no per-market history).
